name: 48792-longdecode-4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, bf16. apache-2.0, ungated, 9.3 GB on disk, NOT in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python` backend).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2560 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, static seed 48792.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 16 prompt tokens and 1000 output tokens, min == max on both, temperature 0 (greedy); the backend sets ignore_eos, so every request emits exactly 1000 tokens.
purpose: A compact 4B storytelling service turning one-line prompts into 1000-token stories for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit 82ae4164ee016d4daecd2033c26f5c0827984a80 -- a source checkout, not a release
# (`git describe --tags --match "v*"` = v0.26.1rc0-202-g82ae4164ee01), so the interpreter is the
# one named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`. The checkpoint is a 9.3 GB first-run download.

model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# The operating point: 256 admitted seats against 256 concurrent streams, so the running batch
# parks at 256 and every step is a full-width decode.
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

enable-prefix-caching: false

# Overrides this commit's default, which is `True`.
enable-chunked-prefill: false

mamba-ssm-cache-dtype: float32

# The alternative prefill backend JIT-compiles on first use and makes startup slow.
gdn-prefill-backend: triton

# The checkpoint carries a vision tower; the workload is text-only, so it is not loaded.
language-model-only: true
trust-remote-code: true

max-model-len: 2048

# Overrides this commit's default, which is 0.92.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
